rebalance_owner_only_documented.meaning: rebalanceFunds is documented (interface and docstring) as callable only by the owner

vault_balance_above_target.meaning: vault currently holds more than its target balance (currentBalance > targetBalance)

redemption_routed_to_custodian_path.meaning: redemptions are routed to the slower custodian path dependent on off-chain actions instead of the fast on-chain path
redemption_routed_to_custodian_path.checkpoint: after attacker calls rebalanceFunds and excess is transferred to custodian

assumptions: The attacker's call to rebalanceFunds is treated as a potential scenario, not an observed transaction.
The excess transferred equals currentBalance - targetBalance DLF, moving the buffer toward its target.
Redemptions that cannot be served from the on-chain buffer are handled by the custodian path.

unresolved.description: Exact targetBalance and buffer amounts are not given numerically; the above-target condition is represented as a report-grounded Boolean.
Report does not state whether the owner exists or has previously called rebalanceFunds.

limitations: The impact is formalized as the absence of routing to the slower custodian path under the documented owner-only rebalance scenario; the attacker's unauthorized call and buffer reduction are not separately encoded as P.
The routing outcome is represented as a Boolean because the report gives no numeric redemption or buffer thresholds.
